news.title: South Korea to invest up to $200B in Alaska LNG pipeline, US power plants, Trump announces
news.summary: South Korea’s government will invest up to $200 billion in U.S. energy infrastructure, including a natural gas pipeline in Alaska, President Trump announced Wednesday.
